note: Adapted from entry 286 of Fauna Sinica, originally in Chinese; only the soldier is recorded (the original gives neither the alate nor the worker); the measurement table is transcribed as given (in the original a few values in the mean column carry three decimals, such as 0.293, and are transcribed unchanged).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head dark yellow, paler in the anterior half; mandibles reddish brown; labrum and antennae yellow; pronotum pale yellowish brown; abdomen and legs pale yellow. Head with scattered long hairs; labrum with 6 pairs of long hairs in a longitudinal row from the apex to the middle and another pair in the middle. Head nearly oval. Labrum ligulate, the apex slightly pointed. Left mandible with 3 marginal teeth; right mandible with 1 small pointed process at the base. The sides of the middle of the postmentum nearly parallel. Antennae 16-segmented, segment 4 shortest, segment 2 about 1.5 times as long as segment 3. Anterior part of the pronotum slightly raised, the anterior and posterior margins distinctly concave in the middle. Measurements (mm, soldier, range/mean): body length 4.36—4.67/4.53; head length including the mandibles 1.65—1.81/1.75; head length to the mandibular base 1.13—1.26/1.21; maximum head width 0.94—1.03/1.01; head height including the postmentum 0.74—0.81/0.77; left mandible length 0.68/0.68; labrum length 0.29/0.29; labrum width 0.29—0.32/0.293; postmentum length 0.65—0.74/0.71; pronotum length 0.45—0.55/0.49; pronotum width 0.74—0.81/0.77; hind tibia length 1.03—1.13/1.08.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Labrum with 6 pairs of long hairs in a longitudinal row; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, right mandible with only 1 small pointed process at the base; antennae 16-segmented, segment 4 shortest, segment 2 about 1.5 times as long as segment 3; the sides of the middle of the postmentum nearly parallel. Distribution known only from Mengding, Gengma, Yunnan (altitude 630 m).
